Container.Name: ktl
Container.Overview: KTL: shared household bills, with each person's own pay, bills and debts kept private. One container: database, accounts, web app, nightly backups and an optional Cloudflare Tunnel. After starting it, open the Web UI and follow /setup (the setup code is in the container log).
Container.Requires: Build or pull the image first: see the README.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: The app, and the address a reverse proxy or the tunnel points at.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, generated secrets and nightly backups.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: Optional: the address people open, e.g. https://ktl.example.com. Easier to set on the setup page; setting it here locks it.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Tunnel token
Config.Description: Optional, and easier on the admin page. Runs the tunnel inside this container; point its public hostname at http://localhost:3000.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the nightly backup time.

Config.Name: Trust X-Forwarded-For
Config.Description: Only if another reverse proxy on your network sits in front (not needed for the tunnel).
